name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
short_desc: Income support of ₹6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across the country.
benefit_summary: ₹6,000 per year released online in three 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 each via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

citation.quote: A landholder farmer's family is defined as 'a family comprising of husband, wife and minor children who owns cultivable land as per land records of the concerned State/UT'.

With a view to provide income support to all landholding farmers' families in the country, having cultivable land, the Central Government has implemented a Central Sector Scheme, namely, 'Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)'.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
short_desc: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
benefit_summary: Margin money subsidy of up to 35% on project loans up to ₹50 Lakhs (Manufacturing) and ₹20 Lakhs (Service/Business).

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
short_desc: Bank loans between Rs. 10 Lakhs and Rs. 1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch.
benefit_summary: Composite loan between Rs. 10 Lakhs and Rs. 1 Crore for setting up greenfield manufacturing, service, or trading units.
documents_required: Proof of Category (SC/ST Certificate or Female Gender)

citation.quote: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs, above 18 years of age.

criteria.label: Target Beneficiary: Woman or SC/ST Entrepreneur

citation.quote: The objective of the Stand Up India scheme is to facilitate bank loans between 10 lakh and 1 Crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
short_desc: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 to unorganized sector workers after age 60.
benefit_summary: Monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 based on contribution, with 100% corpus return to nominee.

citation.quote: Further, PoP-APY shall adhere to any notification issued by Government of India on APY, including minimum entry age of 18 years.
Adhere to any notification issued by Government of India on APY, including maximum entry age of 40 years.
